attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to shuffle your location deck.

Bury this card to add 1d4 and the Fire trait to a combat check by a character at your location. After playing this card, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 6 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.

If this card is in your hand, you may treat it as if it were a monster.
